question: Is the -0.07 / -0.11 pp gap of insightface_r50_wf600k to the buffalo_l card (CFP-FP 99.33, AgeDB-30 98.23) caused by TF32 convolutions in the ONNX Runtime CUDA EP?
method: same E1 protocol (flip, 10-fold) with onnxruntime CUDAExecutionProvider option use_tf32=1 (default, used by E1/E2) vs use_tf32=0; one-off script (input (x-127.5)/127.5 RGB NCHW, batch 128)
answer: identical to 3 decimals -> the gap is not a numerical-precision effect (likely a different evaluation setup behind the card)
